title: [finding] os verify fails the shipped examples/app-todo: a select declared multiple: true is written as a scalar and compared as equal, so its array read-back is reported as a fidelity gap
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position**, a `finding` of class (a). `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21499 dev (os-dev report on #21499, out-of-scope finding 1; base `6f17d1d364`, and the same bytes on PR #21507's branch). Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes. The position is `packages/verify` (`domain:cli` by the lane table).

## What happens (measured, public door)

`os verify --json` in `examples/app-todo` exits **1** with `hardFailures: 1`. The fidelity gap is on `todo_task.tags`: the harness wrote `'important'` and read back `['important']`.

## Why (read from source at `origin/main`)

- `packages/verify/src/derive.ts:88`: `case 'select': case 'radio':` writes one option as a **scalar** with `kind: 'equal'`, and ignores `multiple: true`.
- `:92`: `case 'multiselect': case 'checkboxes':` writes `[opt]` with `kind: 'set'`.
- `examples/app-todo/src/objects/task.object.ts:94` declares `tags: Field.select({ … })` with `multiple: true`. The engine stores and serves it as an array.
- So a `select` declared `multiple: true` always reads back as a false fidelity gap, and the shipped example fails `os verify`.

## Direction (⛔ not a ruling)

The derivation reads the field's declared `multiple`: a multi-valued `select` is written as an array and compared as a set, the way `multiselect` already is. Pin: `examples/app-todo` passes `os verify`, and a single-valued `select` keeps its `equal` comparison (the control).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed: 「os verify fidelity gap select multiple true derive writes scalar reads array app-todo tags exit 1」 gave 1 hit, #21238 (closed: an RLS write check on a multi-valued field, a different door). None covers this.

Dedupe words: os verify fidelity gap multiple select; derive scalar write select multiple true; app-todo verify exit 1 tags; verify derive select multiple set compare.
